top_signals.title: Iris Ohyama data cloud breach exposes info of 7.7 million customers
top_signals.summary: Japanese manufacturer Iris Ohyama, the operator of the Iris Plaza shopping platform, disclosed that personal information belonging to about 7.7 million people may have been exposed after unauthorized access to a third-party cloud service the company used. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
